title: Workshop reservation request
purpose: Capture the request to let visitors reserve a place in a workshop, while leaving payment, account, capacity, cancellation, ownership and release timing unresolved.

scope.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.
The proposed handoff covers a visitor-facing reservation of a place in a workshop; payment, account, capacity and cancellation behavior remain undecided.

requirements.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

stories.text: As a visitor, I want to reserve a place in a workshop.
acceptance_criteria: Given a workshop is offered, when a visitor reserves a place in it, then the reservation is recorded against that workshop.
Given a recorded reservation, when it is inspected, then it identifies the workshop that was reserved.

edge_cases.text: Whether a reservation must be refused once a capacity limit is reached is undecided, so no over-capacity behavior can be specified yet.
Whether a reservation can be cancelled, and what should then happen to the reserved place, is undecided.

dependencies.text: We have not decided whether reservations need payment, an account, a capacity limit or cancellation.
No owner or release date is assigned.

risks.text: If payment, account, capacity or cancellation decisions are made later, the reservation flow described here may need rework.

success_metrics.text: Proposed verification: confirm that a visitor can complete a reservation for an offered workshop and that the recorded reservation can be traced to that workshop.

open_questions: Is there a capacity limit per workshop, and what should happen when it is reached?
Can a reservation be cancelled, and if so what happens to the reserved place?
